scope: Exactly 29 planned of curated 75 R3-v1 requirements
method: Ordered waves and explicit rank are product decisions; score is secondary expert prioritization only, not a measured ROI or developer estimate
scales: Each 1..5. Effort points are ordinal, not person-days.

waves.name: First real customer commercial vertical
waves.exit: External login, tenant onboarding, usable seller surface, browser buyer/seller order and CRM journey qualified

waves.name: Commercial reliability, migration and evidence
waves.exit: Object ACL, cross-page reconciliation, catalog import, sanitized audit, encrypted interactions qualified

waves.name: Financial settlement and typed tasks
waves.exit: Invoice, payment, reconciliation, order finance, minimal tenant tasks and CRM links qualified

waves.name: Operations and advanced workflows
waves.exit: Tasks UX, GEO update, auditor export and separately gated key recovery qualified

waves.name: Growth and recurring revenue
waves.exit: Consent campaigns and tenant subscription metering/billing qualified

gates.requiredQualification: Java service H2 smoke and real PostgreSQL exact-SHA; independent real OIDC/browser/provider/production approvals where applicable

requirements.title: Real issuer/JWKS session onboarding and external email delivery
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Trusted OIDC issuer/JWKS, negative token matrix, real email delivery and session recovery verified in isolated integration environment

requirements.title: Complete first-tenant self-service onboarding
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: First tenant created and selected through authenticated onboarding; membership and tenant A/B isolation E2E

requirements.title: Ready-to-use seller storefront management UI
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Seller can create, edit, publish and pause offerings through usable UI with RBAC, CAS, and persistence after reload

requirements.title: Full real OIDC buyer/seller browser E2E
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Real buyer and seller browser journey from offer to order, confirmation and inventory reserve with restart and denial tests

requirements.title: Qualified staff-facing complete CRM funnel
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Staff can capture/search customer, record qualified interaction and trace accepted order without leaking PII

requirements.title: Typed attachment owner ACL for catalog and sales
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Catalog and sales attachments enforce typed object owner ACL, scan verdict and cross-tenant deny using real storage

requirements.title: Certified tenant-wide as-of reconciliation across pages
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Cross-page as-of reconciliation uses documented consistent snapshot strategy under concurrent writes; drift proof and restart test

requirements.title: Bulk catalog migration with reconciliation report
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Migrated SKUs reconcile counts, prices, owner tenant and invalid rows with immutable import receipt and rerun

requirements.title: Tenant-safe cross-domain sanitized audit query
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Sanitized cross-domain tenant-filtered audit query with pagination, PII redaction, RBAC and PostgreSQL proof

requirements.title: Purpose-scoped encrypted NOTE body and communication outcome
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Purpose-bound encrypted NOTE and outcome accessible only to authorized tenant principals, with tamper and PII assertions

requirements.title: Tenant-owned invoice issue and lifecycle
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Issue versioned tenant invoice from accepted order snapshot with stable totals and idempotent invoice issuance

requirements.title: Payments and allocations with idempotency
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Record idempotent payments and allocations; validate partial, duplicate, overpayment and cross-tenant denial

requirements.title: Reconciliation and immutable financial events
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Reconcile settlements and immutable event ledger with deterministic retry, transaction rollback and correction policy

requirements.title: Invoice/payment/settlement order integration
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Order-linked invoice/payment/settlement never conflates fulfillment and payment; cross-domain E2E and rollback

requirements.title: Order-linked finance view and audit
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Authorized seller sees invoice, paid/unpaid allocation and immutable audit per order with tenant isolation

requirements.title: Tenant-owned task commands and transitions
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Tenant-owned task create/assign/complete state-machine with membership and unauthorized-write tests

requirements.title: CRM interaction-to-task typed link
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Typed CRM interaction-to-task reference maintains source ownership, consistency and cross-tenant rejection

requirements.title: Task creation and completion through TASKS ownership
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Create/complete task through CRM interaction without shadow TASKS tables; state and permission evidence

requirements.title: Assigned task lists, reminders and deadlines
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Bounded personal/team task queries and durable deadline/reminder behavior, idempotent delivery

requirements.title: Tasks browser acceptance and permission gates
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Browser task flow with assignments, recovery, back navigation, keyboard accessibility and access gates

requirements.title: Verified full Kazakhstan directory update lifecycle
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Repeatable KZ reference update, source version, rollback and reconciliation of code mappings

requirements.title: Auditor UI and bounded compliant export
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Bounded compliant export and auditor UI with sanitized records, object access checks and audit of exports

requirements.title: Operational tenant-key rotation and recovery
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Prove distributed generation fencing, decrypt-only migration, tenant recovery and crash/rollback on PostgreSQL before enabling rotation

requirements.title: Purpose-bound customer consent targeting
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Purpose-scoped consent snapshot eligibility with revoked/expired suppression and PII boundaries

requirements.title: Campaign lifecycle and consent-gated dispatch
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Campaign lifecycle and consent-gated dispatch with idempotent fanout, opt-out and tenant quotas

requirements.title: Campaign delivery status and suppression proof
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Track delivery outcome and suppression proof, deduplicated events and replay after provider failure

requirements.title: Tenant plan entitlement evaluation
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Tenant plan entitlement checks at service boundaries with deny-before-write and explicit downgrade policy

requirements.title: Usage metering and quota enforcement
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Idempotent usage metering, thresholds and tenant-scoped quota enforcement under concurrency

requirements.title: Subscription billing lifecycle and renewal proof
requirements.acceptanceCriterion: Subscription renewal/invoice evidence is durable and idempotent; verify failed payment/retry and cancellation
